description: Workbench copy of gateway QUESTION_SET_V1. Matches OpenRouter Decisions criteria shape.

requests_record_lookup.instructions: Is the user asking to retrieve stored information?

criteria.true: The text asks to look up, show, list, or retrieve existing record data.
criteria.false: The text does not ask to retrieve stored information.

requests_patient_creation.instructions: Is a new patient/admission being described for registration?

criteria.true: The text describes admitting or registering a new patient/admission.
criteria.false: No new patient registration is being requested.

criteria.true: The text requests a bed/ward/location transfer or update.
criteria.false: No location or transfer change is requested.

requests_task_or_reminder.instructions: Is work to be scheduled, completed, cancelled or rescheduled?

criteria.true: The text schedules, completes, cancels, or reschedules a task/reminder.
criteria.false: No task or reminder change is requested.

contains_medication_change.instructions: Does this include a proposed or reported medication change?

criteria.true: The text starts, stops, changes, or reports a medication/dose change.

contains_multiple_patient_contexts.instructions: Does the source appear to refer to multiple patients?

criteria.true: The text clearly refers to more than one patient.
criteria.false: The text refers to at most one patient context.

processing_demand.instructions: How much interpretation does this input need?

source_supports_action.instructions: Does the supplied source support this proposed action?

criteria.true: The supplied source text supports the proposed action.
criteria.false: The source does not support the proposed action, or support is unclear.

unresolved_ambiguity.instructions: Does this proposal still depend on ambiguous intent or attribution?

criteria.true: Important intent or attribution remains ambiguous.
criteria.false: Intent and attribution are sufficiently clear.
